articles.title: Europe Heat Wave Sends Power Prices Soaring as Alerts Spread
articles.summary: A heat wave gripping western Europe is forecast to strengthen this week, with days of dangerously hot and humid conditions and record-breaking temperatures in France, the UK, Spain and Germany.

articles.title: Oil Declines After US-Iran Peace Talks Show Signs of Progress
articles.summary: Oil declined as Iran said there had been progress in peace talks with the US, bolstering hopes for a recovery in flows from the Persian Gulf.

articles.title: RBC Says Stocks Can Weather Fed Hikes, But Not Too Many
articles.summary: Lori Calvasina, head of US equity strategy research at RBC Capital Markets, says the strength of US corporate earnings is propping up stocks amid concern that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates. But there are limits to how many hikes the market can withstand, she says on Bloomberg Television's ``Surveillance.'' (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Stocks Drift Despite Drop in Oil on US-Iran Talks: Markets Wrap
articles.summary: US stocks are heading for a quiet open after the long weekend, with equities finding little support from lower oil prices amid signs of diplomatic headway between the US and Iran.

articles.title: Oil Is Starting to Flow Through Hormuz Despite Iran’s Warnings
articles.summary: Estimates vary, but more crude is clearly moving out of the Persian Gulf.

articles.title: Copper Rallies as Peace-Talk Progress Eases Inflation Fears
articles.summary: Copper prices rose after Iran said there had been “major progress” in peace talks with the US, boosting expectations that traffic through the Strait of Hormuz may recover and ease inflation pressures.

articles.title: Cuomo to Lead Crypto Venture With New York Stock Exchange Owner
articles.summary: Former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo is starting a second act: Helping cryptocurrency exchange operator OKX and the owner of the New York Stock Exchange build a new business that merges digital and traditional finance markets.

articles.title: Saudi Central Bank Said to Pull Money From at Least Two Managers
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia’s monetary authority has pulled billions of dollars from at least two global asset managers in recent months, in a sign that the custodian of one of the world’s deepest pools of capital is growing more selective with deployment.

articles.title: Treasuries Pare Declines as Oil Price Drops on US-Iran Progress
articles.summary: Treasuries fell as trading resumed following a US public holiday with Washington and Tehran working to hammer out details of a peace accord.

articles.title: Colombia Bonds Rise as Market Favorite Espriella Wins Vote
articles.summary: Colombian bonds rose after Abelardo de la Espriella won one of the tightest presidential elections in the nation’s history, setting the stage for a swing to market-friendly policies that have sparked rallies across Latin America.

articles.title: Starmer on Brink With Resignation Seen Imminent | The Opening Trade 6/22/2026
articles.summary:
Allies of Keir Starmer expect him to set out a timetable for his departure as UK prime minister, putting Britain on course for its seventh premier in a decade and paving the way for Andy Burnham to replace him. Starmer being on the brink of leaving office comes after the landslide election victory he secured in 2024, which returned Labour to power after 14 years out of office.

articles.title: Pound Weakens Amid Starmer Resignation; Iran Cites Peace Talk Progress | Bloomberg Brief 6/22/2026
articles.summary: US equity futures waver and oil dips as Iran cites "major progress" in peace talks with the US. The pound falls against major currencies as UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer announces his resignation. Monica Defend of Amundi Investment Institute looks ahead to a busy week of economic data.   (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Uzbekistan Seeks More Western Gas Investors After BP Deal
articles.summary: Uzbekistan is stepping up efforts to bring major European and US energy companies into its natural gas sector, after last month securing investment from BP Plc.

articles.title: Uber-Backed Electric Bike Firm Lime Seeks $180.9 Million in IPO
articles.summary: Lime, the electric bike and scooter rental firm backed by Uber Technologies Inc., and it shareholders are seeking to raise as much as $180.9 million in its US initial public offering.

articles.title: Pound, Gilts Rise After UK Prime Minister Starmer Resigns
articles.summary: The pound and gilts edged higher after UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer resigned and the path to power began to clear for the frontrunner to succeed him.

articles.title: Emerging-Market Stocks Mark Fresh High as US-Iran Talks Progress, Oil Falls
articles.summary: Emerging-market stocks touched a fresh all-time high on signs of progress in US-Iran peace talks, with Asia’s technology giants extending their rally as investors continued to pour money into companies linked to artificial intelligence.

articles.title: EasyJet Rebuffs Castlelake Bid That’s Well Above Share Price
articles.summary: EasyJet Plc has rebuffed three separate offers from Castlelake LP, prompting the investment firm to take its proposal valuing the budget carrier at about £4.74 billion ($6.3 billion) directly to shareholders.

articles.title: Portugal Eyes Wealth Fund for Strategic Stakes, Premier Says
articles.summary: The Portuguese government plans to create a sovereign wealth fund that would allow the state to retain stakes in strategic sectors of the economy.

articles.title: ‘Buy Europe’ Trade Returns as Stagflation Fears Ease: Markets Daily
articles.summary: Bets on easing inflation and stronger economic growth are boosting the region’s stocks.

articles.title: UK Bonds Welcome Lower Odds of Prolonged Leadership Battle
